title: Write the sharing guide
objective: Write docs/sharing.md for people new to the library: what a share link is, who can open one, and what a visitor sees. Use exactly these three second-level headings, in this order: "## Share links", "## Who can open a link", "## What a visitor sees", each followed by at least one line of prose. Say that a link's address is /l/<link id> and that a visitor needs no account. Keep it under 80 lines. Change no other file.
acceptance: docs/sharing.md exists with the three headings in order, each with prose
It says a link lives at /l/<link id> and that a visitor needs no account
